releaseNotes:
Queue has now been optimized for iPad - enjoy Queue, beautifully designed for larger screens.

Import directly from TV Time to transfer your full history over to Queue in just a few taps. Go to Settings to get started. 

Now supporting multiple languages! Go to Settings to adjust the language for Queue.

Under Advanced Settings, select "open to Currently Watching" to go straight to your list of titles to check off what you've seen!
description:
Do you love watching movies and shows but are tired of the headache of trying to keep track of everything across a million streaming services? You've come to the right place. 

Queue is the easiest and most fun way to track your movies and shows, discover new things to watch, see where things are available to stream, and share what you're watching with your friends. Whether you're watching alone, with a friend, or planning movie night with someone special, let us be your ultimate companion to what you're watching. Queue is your guide to TV and movies on streaming and in theaters. Whether you're on the couch for some TV Time or to go on a movie marathon, Queue is the ultimate companion for whatever you're watching next.

*See where anything is available to stream, no matter where you are in the world. Queue supports 100+ countries and 200+ streaming services, including YouTube
*Connect your streaming services and automatically pull in your full watch history and everything you're currently watching
*Watch trailers - explore a stream of trailers through the Explore tab to see what's new In Theaters, Coming Soon, Now Streaming, and more
*If you've been tracking on your phone what you want to watch, Copy and Paste your list from Notes, spreadsheet, anything, and in seconds it'll appear on your Queue. Upgrade your watchlist!
*Add the Friends Widget to your home screen to see what your friends are watching. Works best when you both sync your streaming services!
*View all your upcoming premieres and episodes airings on one beautiful calendar view
*Create custom lists to show off your favorites or help keep your organized. You can even invite friends or partners to collaborate on your lists together!
*Swipe with a friend to help you agree on something to watch, or swipe alone build up your Queue
*Don't know what to watch? Save time and use the Spinner to help you decide 
*Never miss a movie or series again with notifications to remind you when titles premiere and new seasons air
*Track your series - we have all the air dates for seasons and episodes to help you stay up to date 
*Unlock fun badges through different challenges in the app

Keep in mind we aren't a streaming service - you still need to have access to streaming services in order to watch the movies and shows you discover on Queue. But if you have streaming services like Netflix, Prime Video, Disney+ and more, you'll love how Queue keeps your organized for your movies and shows. Whether you watch on a phone, television, computer, or tablet, Queue is the best companion for watching. Become the most knowledgeable movie and show person in your friend group without leaving the sofa. Discover something new, add it to your Queue, see where it's available to stream, then just watch on your favorite device.

We’d love to hear from you! We try to respond to all support emails as quickly as possible. Send your questions, feedback, or just say hi at info@queue.co.
